name: mj359d-cos-dependency-dedupe
goal: Replay the recorded CoS queue and deliver a dependency update once per item and text change.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Primary Mac CoS transcript shows repeated watchdog deliveries for eight alert rows from 15:30Z onward. Their ids remain unsent. Expect one delivery per item text and digest visibility for open blockers.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing delivery test retries only the same alert ids. Extend it with a sanitized recorded eight-row queue and replay a new id for unchanged text; keep no-receipt retry coverage.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At 98193e2938 the unchanged Tracker delivery suite failed because the replay sent two eight-item batches instead of one. Red checkpoint retained by loop record.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Persist receipts per item and full CoS message text. Recover missed tmux acknowledgements from bounded same-project Claude prompt or queue receipts.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Frozen test corpus and one command failed at 98193e2938 and passed at ea99e155f1. The PR also exercises transcript receipt recovery in a second test.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
